channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: New federal funding to open for agriculture, agri-food market diversification
item.description: A total of $75 million over five years will be available under the AgriMarketing program’s market diversification streams, federal Agriculture Minister Heath Macdonald announced in a news release on Feb. 10.

item.title: Farm Credit Canada-led coalition to invest $5 billion into agriculture innovation
item.description: FCC announces $5 billion into agriculture innovation by 2030

item.title: U.S. agriculture groups tout benefits of trade agreement
item.description: The North American trade agreement pushed U.S. agricultural exports up by $20 billion since it took effect in 2020, according to a new study from a broad coalition of American farm organizations that support renewing the deal.

item.title: Agriculture department officials address research cuts
item.description: Members of the House of Commons agriculture committee from all parties expressed concern about the recently announced cuts and closures at federal research centres as they began an emergency study on the matter Feb. 10.

item.title: Fine against B.C. ostrich farm dropped on tribunal review
item.description: The $10,000 fine against Universal Ostrich Farms has been dropped after review by the Canada Agriculture Review Tribunal

item.title: FCC platform to tell story of Canadian agriculture, food brand
item.description: FCC launches Let’s Grow Canada platform to tell the story of Canadian agriculture

item.title: Agriculture department officials address research cuts; to hold emergency study
item.description: Members of the House of Commons agriculture committee from all parties expressed concern about the recently announced cuts and closures at federal research centres as they began an emergency study on the matter Feb. 10.

item.title: Flour production slumps in the U.S., increases in Canada
item.description: U.S. flour production in 2025 was the lowest in 14 years.

item.title: World’s winter wheat crops look good for now
item.description: Winter wheat crops look good in the Black Sea and the U.S., although there is plenty of drought in the U.S. winter wheat region.

item.title: ICE Canada Weekly: Canola needs to back away from highs
item.description: Concerns about canola getting too expensive have crept into the Canadian oilseed’s recent rally on the Intercontinental Exchange.
